caption:
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

Forty Hadith of an-Nawawi, Hadith 13 (also in Bukhari and Muslim). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese and Malay renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.primary_text: Forty Hadith of an-Nawawi, Hadith 13, narrated by Abu Hamzah Anas bin Malik (may Allah be pleased with him); also recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari [13] and Sahih Muslim [45]
sourcing.arabic:
Matn only (isnad and citation tail omitted for slide length, following the same precedent as bukhari-1-1.meta.json), edition ara-nawawi, cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fawazahmed0/hadith-api. Live-fetched and verified this session (2026-09-15) via GET /editions/ara-nawawi/13.json. The raw field also contained a stray HTML '
' tag and a repeated bracketed attribution tail after the matn+citation, both dropped for the slide (matn preserved verbatim, character-for-character).
sourcing.english: Edition eng-nawawi, cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fawazahmed0/hadith-api. Live-fetched this session via GET /editions/eng-nawawi/13.json. Matn quoted verbatim including the source's own bracketed interpolation '[truly]'. Checked editions.json for a named translator: the 'author' field for this edition is 'Imam Nawawi' (the compiler of the original collection, not a translator), and no separate translator name is given anywhere in the API's metadata - so the on-slide and citation-slide credit says 'translator not specified by source' rather than asserting a name (e.g. the commonly-published Ibrahim/Johnson-Davies translation) that could not be verified as the actual source of this specific text.
sourcing.chinese_korean_japanese_malay: No Chinese, Korean, Japanese, or Malay edition exists in the fawazahmed0/hadith-api catalogue for any collection, including nawawi (confirmed this session by re-fetching the full editions.json: the nawawi collection lists only Arabic (two variants), Bengali, English, French and Turkish; a second full-catalogue scan for a Malay edition across every collection, done separately when Malay was added, also came back empty). These four renderings are therefore my own careful translation from the verified Arabic and English matn above, not a named external source, and are labelled as translations on-slide and in the caption rather than attributed to a scholar who did not produce them.
sourcing.malay: Added 2026-09-15 as a permanent 6th language for the channel at the owner's explicit request. No Malay hadith-api edition exists (see chinese_korean_japanese_malay above), so this is my own translation from the verified Arabic matn and English rendering, labelled transparently on-slide and in the citation as a translation rather than attributed to a named scholar.
sourcing.verification_note: Arabic and English matn are primary-sourced and citable, live-fetched this session (2026-09-15) via cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fawazahmed0/hadith-api@1/editions/{ara-nawawi,eng-nawawi}/13.json, both HTTP 200 - re-fetched fresh rather than trusted from any prior session's memory, per the channel's hard sourcing requirement. Chinese, Korean and Japanese are transparently labelled translations. See channels.json's ig-blankdiscussions._niche_note for why honest sourcing is a hard requirement for this channel.
sourcing.compliance_check: Manually checked against scripts/data/compliance-policy.json's halal keyword-blocklists (intoxicants, pork, gambling, riba, immodesty, profanity, superstition, origins_patterns, animate_imagery, context_review) since compliance-gate.mjs does not cover this channel's schema. No blocklisted terms present in any of the six language texts (rechecked after the Malay slide was added 2026-09-15); no imagery generated at all (pure typography slides). Content is a core ethical teaching on brotherly love with no sensitive subject matter - no context_review flags apply. Clean.
